description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - The Industrial Disputes between Mrs. L. G. D. Gunathilake and Spring Valley Estate, and  two other notices
categorisation: This gazette content primarily consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. It references existing legislation, exercises powers granted by that legislation, and creates legally binding arbitration processes. This falls squarely under "Legal notices and statutory declarations" and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" within the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While a government minister is named, the content does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the legal/regulatory action he is taking pursuant to statutory authority.
